items.label: Daily Drawdown
items.detail: Maximum loss allowed within one trading day. Trading day runs from 17:00:00 NY Time to 16:59:59 NY Time the following day. At 17:00:00 NY Time, the Daily Drawdown threshold is recalculated by reference to the previous Trading Day's closing balance. Open equity and floating losses are included. Static — does not trail upward with profits. Hard Breach = immediate account termination. No warning, no Strike applies.

items.label: Maximum Drawdown
items.detail: Total loss allowed from the Initial Account Balance. Static — does not trail upward with profits and does not adjust based on the highest account balance reached. Open equity and floating losses are included. Hard Breach = immediate and permanent account termination. No warning, no Strike applies.

items.label: Floating Drawdown
items.detail: Unrealised loss on open positions on the same symbol, measured as % of Initial Account Balance, on a combined basis per symbol. Threshold is 2.0%. Reaching the threshold does not result in a real-time alert, email alert, platform notification, soft warning, Strike, Account Reset, Reward Payment reduction, or account closure. Relevant findings may be included in the Challenge Phase Progression Report. Unlimited soft warnings may be issued during the Challenge Phase.

items.label: Minimum Profitable Days
items.detail: Required to progress through each Challenge stage. A profitable day = account balance at 17:00:00 NY Time exceeds previous trading day's closing balance by at least 0.5% of Initial Account Balance. No progression is allowed until the requirement is met. Minimum Profitable Days do not shorten any Reward Payment cooldown or Payout Cycle.

items.label: Profit Target
items.detail: Phase 1 target is 7.5% of the Initial Account Balance. Phase 2 target is 5.0% of the Initial Account Balance. The Trader must achieve the applicable profit target, complete the applicable Minimum Profitable Days, close all open positions, and comply with Section 7. Finotive may review the Account for compliance before granting progression or Simulated Funded Status.

items.label: Daily Drawdown
items.detail: Same as Challenge Phase. Hard Breach = immediate account termination. No warning, no Strike applies.

items.label: Maximum Drawdown
items.detail: Same as Challenge Phase. Hard Breach = immediate and permanent account termination. No warning, no Strike applies.

items.label: Floating Drawdown
items.detail: Threshold is 2.0% per symbol on combined basis. An early soft reminder may be issued when Floating Drawdown reaches 1.5%. If Floating Drawdown reaches or exceeds 2.0%, it results in 1 Strike and Reward Payment reduction to 10% for the relevant Payout Cycle. Only one Strike may be issued per trade and instrument combination — continued drawdown on the same open position does not generate additional Strikes. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Minimum Profitable Days Between Payouts
items.detail: Required before payout or scaling request. A profitable day = account balance at 17:00:00 NY Time exceeds previous trading day's closing balance by at least 0.5% of Initial Account Balance. No payout or scaling request is permitted until the requirement is met. Minimum Profitable Days do not shorten any Reward Payment cooldown or Payout Cycle.

items.label: Profit Target
items.detail: No staged profit target applies during the Funded Phase. The Trader may trade freely subject to all risk limits, Reward Payment conditions, and compliance requirements.

items.label: Notional Volume Limit Note
items.detail: The Notional Volume Limit controls the maximum permitted open notional exposure for the Account. It is separate from platform leverage, margin usage, and buying power. A trade may be permitted by margin but still exceed the Notional Volume Limit. The Dashboard Notional Volume Calculator provides real-time guidance on maximum position size, taking into account account size, balance, open positions, and other relevant risk parameters. The Trader is responsible for checking exposure before opening trades.

items.label: Hard Breach
items.detail: Triggered by: (1) Daily Drawdown breach, (2) Maximum Drawdown breach, or (3) Five cumulative Strikes. No warning and no graduated consequence applies. Results in immediate or permanent account closure.

items.label: Soft Breach — Notional (Challenge)
items.detail: Notional Volume breach in Challenge Phase = Immediate Strike + Account Reset. If account balance is negative, the reset is placed on hold until trader returns the account to at least break-even. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Soft Breach — Notional (Funded)
items.detail: Notional Volume breach in Funded Phase = Immediate Strike + Reward Payment reduction to 10% for the relevant Payout Cycle. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Soft Breach — Floating DD (Funded)
items.detail: Floating DD ≥ 2.0% in Funded Phase = 1 Strike + Reward Payment reduction to 10% for the relevant Payout Cycle. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Soft Warning Only (Challenge)
items.detail: Floating DD, Realised-Loss Recovery, Scalping, Concentration, Liquidity Abuse in Challenge Phase = no real-time alert. Relevant findings may be included in the Challenge Phase Progression Report.

items.label: Conditional Strike (Funded)
items.value: If active at payout: 1 Strike + payout to 10%
items.detail: Applies to Scalping, Excessive One-Sided Position Concentration, Liquidity Abuse in Funded Phase. The Trader may continue trading to reverse the condition before submitting a Reward Payment Request. If the Trader submits a Reward Payment Request while the condition remains active, one (1) Conditional Strike is recorded and the Reward Payment for that Payout Cycle is reduced to 10%.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Standard initial Reward Split for Funded 2-Step Challenge accounts. The Reward Split may increase through scaling up to a maximum of 95%, subject to eligibility, account status, promotions, and the Terms.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: First Reward Payment Request is available on demand once the Account is in Simulated Funded Status and eligible. After the first approved Reward Payment, a seven (7) calendar day cooldown applies between subsequent Reward Payment Requests unless the Dashboard specifies otherwise.

items.label: Minimum Reward Payment Request
items.detail: For 2-Step Challenge-Funded Accounts, no minimum Reward Payment Request amount applies and the 1% minimum rule does not apply.

items.label: Payout Reduction
items.detail: Each Strike in the Funded Phase reduces the relevant Payout Cycle Reward Payment to 10%. Where any Strike would become the fifth cumulative Strike, the five-Strike Hard Breach outcome applies instead of a 10% reduced Reward Payment. If a Strike has been issued, trader must withdraw the full available amount — partial withdrawal is not permitted.

items.label: Fee Refund
items.detail: 100% challenge fee refunded on the 30th funded day if the Account remains in net profit. The refund is automatic where eligibility is met and is returned to the original payment method. The refund is not contingent on the Trader requesting or receiving a Reward Payment. No refund is available if a Hard Breach, fraud, prohibited conduct, false information, chargeback, or other breach occurs before the refund date.

items.label: Scaling Cycle
items.detail: Challenge-Funded Accounts may be eligible for scaling on a rolling ninety (90) day Scaling Cycle.

items.label: Scaling Requirements
items.detail: Requirements include: at least fifty (50) trades, no more than 7.5% of total net profit from any single trade, achievement of the applicable 90-day target, at least two (2) out of three (3) profitable months, no Hard Breach, and full compliance with Section 7.

items.label: 90-Day Scaling Target
items.detail: The 90-day scaling target for 2-Step Challenge-Funded Accounts is 10% of the Initial Account Balance.

items.label: Balance Increase
items.detail: Balance progression increases by 30% per successful Scaling Cycle, subject to the published Dashboard schedule.

items.label: Maximum Scaled Balance
items.detail: Maximum per-account scaled balance of USD 680,000 unless amended by Finotive.

items.label: Account Refresh
items.detail: An Account Refresh is a paid option that may allow an eligible funded Challenge Account to restart under fresh conditions where the Account is active and within 10% of the Maximum Drawdown threshold, subject to Dashboard availability, payment of the applicable fee, and Finotive approval. Eligible funded Challenge Accounts may request up to three (3) Account Refreshes per funded account.

items.label: Account Reset
items.detail: An Account Reset returns the Account to its Initial Account Balance and resets relevant performance metrics. A Reset is primarily used where the Notional Volume Limit is breached during Challenge phases. If the Account Balance is below break-even at the time a Reset would otherwise apply, the Reset is placed on hold until the Trader recovers to at least break-even. Finotive may refuse, delay, or suspend a Reset or Refresh where repeated activity indicates abusive, highly speculative, non-replicable, or manipulative behaviour.
